newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW - Bank/Portugal cuts repo rate.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW - Bank/Portugal cuts repo rate.

text.p: The following are some instant analyst reactions to the Bank of Portugal's surprise decision to cut its repo rate 30 basis points to 6.0 percent and lower its drain rate by 10 basis points to 5.7 percent.

"It was unexpected give the position of the escudo. The Bank is probably anticipating the April inflation figure which is expected to be good and expectations that the Bank of Spain will cut rates next Friday.

"The stance of the Bank seems intelligent to me and correct given the approach of the French elections and some exchange turbulence that could come next week in dollar-mark which would then impact the mark and the Europeans (currencies)."

"I expected the Bank of Portugal to wait for the inflation numbers (but) because all the fundamentals allowed it (a cut), it was just a question of timing. On the reasons, I think it had to do with the fact that the escudo was reasonably stable and the market had discounted a (eventual) cut, giving little importance to the timing."
